authority: Parliament of India: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (central penalties)
coverage: Central statutory penalty ranges. States may notify their own compounding amounts under Section 200.
review_note: Statute text read on Indian Kanoon because India Code was unreachable from the research environment. Confirm on indiacode.nic.in before marking VERIFIED_PRIMARY.

offences.offence: Using a handheld communications device while driving

source.title: Section 184, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (text as amended), Indian Kanoon

offences.notes: First offence: imprisonment of 6 months to 1 year and/or this fine. Subsequent offence within 3 years: up to 2 years and/or up to Rs 10,000.

source.title: Section 184, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (text as amended), Indian Kanoon

offences.notes: Same penalty range as handheld device use, which the Section 184 explanation lists as dangerous driving.

offences.offence: Using earphones or headphones while driving
offences.notes: The central Section 184 text names handheld communication devices only. Some authorities (see IN-WB-KOL) list earphone use under Section 184.
